about: Harlan's first-person hands (option 2, #914): MetaHuman Sean's hands cut at the wrist with a cuff and sleeve, fitted per gun. HeldHand.hold(key, painted) reads these where his hands are in (assets/people/private/harlan_fp.glb), else each viewmodel keeps its own constant. Fingers: degrees of grasp (the middle joint; HeldHand.GRASP couples the three). Thumbs: [[root x, y, z], bend 1, bend 2]. Places: design inches (the rifle) or metres and degrees under the camera ([at, rot]: the Colt's poses).
